description: NaMg₁₄FeO₁₆ is alpha Po-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.14 Å) and four longer (2.27 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.23 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.18 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.18 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-10°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.19 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.05 Å) and two longer (2.14 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one Fe atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OMg₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.15 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are two shorter (2.10 Å) and two longer (2.15 Å) O-Mg bond lengths. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-5°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Mg and two equivalent Fe atoms to form OMg₄Fe₂ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₄Fe₂ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₄Fe₂ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. The O-Mg bond length is 2.00 Å. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are a spread of O-Mg bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.15 Å.
